description: Source code for managing cell group configurations and UE configurations in a scheduler, including classes for cell group pool, cell configuration, and UE configuration updates.

classes.name: du_cell_config_pool
classes.description: Manages configuration for a single cell, including updating UE configurations and adding BWP configurations.

classes.name: du_cell_group_config_pool
classes.description: Manages a group of cells, allowing addition and removal of cells, and creation/reconfiguration of UEs within the group.

methods.name: update_ue
methods.description: Updates UE configuration based on current cell and BWP settings.

methods.name: add_bwp
methods.description: Adds a BWP (Bandwidth Part) configuration to UE response.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell configuration to the cell group.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the group.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates a new UE with specified configuration.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing UE with new parameters.
